tei:div.tei:p: tshe 'gugs bzhugs so// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad gnas skabs dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las sgrol te 'chi med kyi rig 'dzin thob pa dang*/ mthar thug 'chi med padma thod phreng rtsal gyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'chi med tshe 'gugs pa'i phrin las zab mo la brtson par bgyi'o snyam du theg chen spyi yi sems bskyed pa dang*/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad ye gdod ma nyid nas/ ngo bo ye dag gzhi lhun grub kyi sangs rgyas la/ glo bur gyi dri ma 'bral rung gi sgrib pa thams cad bsal nas rang gi ye shes mngon du mnyes par bya'o snyam du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sems ye shes su bskyed pa dang*/ gnas yul snod bcud thams cad ye nas dag pa rab 'byams lha'i 'khor lo snang srid gzhir bzhugs kyi sangs rgyas la gzhir bzhengs su gsal gdab pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun spyaud rnams kyang mngon par 'du byas te gsan 'tshal/ gang zhig gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ rang cag rnams kyi lus rten dal brgyad 'byor bcu 'khor lo chen po bzhi dang ldan pa 'di nyid rnyed par dka' ba u duṃ wa ri'i me tog dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu ste/ slob dpon tsand+ra go mi'i zhal nas/ bde gshegs lam bstan (512)'gro ba 'dren par chas gyur cing*// sems kyi stobs chen mi yi rnyed pa gang yin pa// lam de lha dang lha min mir bcas thams cad dang*// mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi'am ci dang lto 'phye dang*// mi yi dngos po shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed gyur cing*// don du brnag pa gang yin de nyid rgyun du sgrubs/ zhes gsungs pa'i chos ldan gyi rten 'di nyid yun ring du 'tsho ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos te/ slob dpon ngag dbang grags pa'i zhal nas/ chos spyod dbang po dul ba ni// 'khor bar yis ni ji srid 'tsho// de srid bsod nams ye shes tshogs// byang chub sgrub byed rab tu bskyed// 'khor bar srog la mi gces pa// ci yang yod pa ma mthong bas// de bas myur du thabs mang pos// 'chi ba bslu ba kun tu bskyed/

ces gsungs pa ltar rang cag rnams tshe dang las dang bsod nams zad pa gsum gyis 'chi ba'i dbang du 'gyur la/ tshe zad la tshe sgrub dang*/ las zad la srog bslu/ bsod zad la yar dkon mchog la mchod pa/ mar ngan slong la sbyin pa la sogs pas gso dgos la/ skabs 'dir tshe nyams pa'i rkyen ni/ tshe rgyud bdud rtsi 'khyil pa las/ dam sel grib dang yid chad dang ba dang*// zhe sdang drag pos rbod gtong tshar gcod dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa dang*// gnas ngan dag tu gnas skabs (513)'di dag gi tshe nyams dbugs dang bgegs kyi dbang du 'gyur/ zhes dang*// tshe nyams pa'i rtags ni/ ji skad du/ 'khor la khro shing sdug skad 'byin pa dang*// bzhin 'gyur spyod lam rnams ni 'chal ba dang*/ kha zas rnams kyang yid du mi 'ong ba// de dag rnams ni nyams pa'i rtags su bshad// ces so/ gso byed kyi slob dpon ni/ ji skad du/ ting 'dzin phra mo las su rung ba dang*// rgyud kyi don la mkhas shing dbang thob pa// mthu byin che zhing dam tshig nye bar srung*// 'di gsum gang gis bkug kyang khug par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs la/ ji ltar tshe nyams pa gso bar byed pa'i thabs la'ang*/ rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba des/ 'chi med sgrub pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs rgya cher bka' bstsal ba'i nang nas/ skabs su bab pa 'di ni snga 'gyur zab mo gter gyi phyogs/ de la'ang phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i thugs gter chain mo lnga las/ shar gter smin pa 'bras bu lta bu'i phyogs su gtogs pa ste/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ lho phyogs 'od zer ming can sprul pa'i sku// zab don snying thig chos kyi 'gro ba 'dren// 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing du 'phen pa 'byung*/ zhes sogs rdo rje'i lung gis gsal bar bsngags pa'i chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan dang*/ rgyal sras lha rje mchog(514)grub rgyal po zung du 'jug pa'i rnam par 'phrul ba/

kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas dgongs gter nam mkha' mdzod kyi chos sde/ rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying gi thig le'i nang sgrub rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshe sgrub bdud rtsi bum bcud dang rjes 'brel ba/ 'chi med tshe 'gugs pa'i phrin las tsam mdzad pa la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sa phyogs thams cad zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo'i zhing khams kyi bkod pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs padma dang nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng*/ khyed rang o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing spyan zisam par gzigs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pas tshig dbang gi dgongs pa mthar phyin pa'i brdar/ gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsdigs pa'i tshul gyi 'dzin pa/ phyags g.yon pa mnyam par bzhag pa'i steng du/ gsang dbang gi dgongs pa mthar phyin pa'i brdar/ rdo rje bde skyong gi bum pa bdud rtsis bkang ba dang*/ bum dbang gi dgongs pa mthar phyin pa'i brdar/ 'chi med tshe'i bum pa dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan can brtsegs mar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung g.yon du sher dbang gi dgongs pa mthar phyin pa'i brdar/ yum lha lcam me tog man da ra ba dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ sku la sngags kyi chas rdzogs (515)mthing nag dar gyi phod chen/ rab byung chas rdzogs chos gos dmar po gser gyi ha ris can/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal dbang gi chas rdzogs za 'og gi ber smug brtsegs mar gsol ba/ dbu la 'dab ldan padma'i mnyen zhu gsol zhing*/ zhabs rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyi thugs kar nyi zla gwa'u'i nang du hrīḥyig sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gsal thob/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi sne la/ sprul pa'i rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro nyi zer gyi rdul lta bu 'phros pas/

brtan g.yo snod bcud kyi dwangs ma ma lus pa dang*/ drang srong gi rig 'dzin rnams kyi bskal bar nod pa'i tshe bcud/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi mthu byin dang bcas pa 'od zer 'ja' tshon thig le'i rnam pa spyan drangs te khyed rang la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ: rang snang zangs mdog= sogs/ de ltar tshe 'gugs shing bcud bsdus pas/ lus kyi nang thams cad 'chi med dwangs ma'i bcud du 'dril nas tshe dpag med ye shes sems dpa' til gyi gang bu kha phye ba lta bus gang zhing*/ mthar 'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pas/ rdo rje 'dzin pas kyang mi shig (516) pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ āḥ 'byung lnga'i dbyings su= sogs/ bkra shis ci rigs brjod/ 'di bris dge bas 'gro ba rnams// chos sku'i rgyal sa thob pa dang*// zab mo snying thig bstan pa yang*// phyogs bcur dar zhing rgyas par shog sarba maṃ ga lam// dge'o//
